description: This Java class defines the 'AppUser' entity within the Fineract financial platform. It models application users, including their credentials, roles, permissions, linked staff and office entities, and account status. It provides methods for managing user data, permissions, password changes, and soft deletion, integrating with Spring Security and JPA for persistence.

classes.name: AppUser
classes.description: Entity class representing an application user, managing user credentials, roles, permissions, linked staff/office, and account status within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AppUser instance from provided JSON command, including role assignments and optional password generation.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Facilitates changing the user's password, returning a map of actual changes.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's encoded password, handling password expiration flags.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of the user, marking it as deleted and revoking access.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns security authorities based on user roles and permissions for Spring Security.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's current encoded password.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Provides a display name for the user, prioritizing staff display name if available.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates if the user account has not expired.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates if the user account is not locked.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Checks if user credentials are valid and not expired.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the user account is enabled.

methods.name: getStaffId
methods.description: Retrieves the linked staff member's ID if available.

methods.name: getStaffDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of the linked staff.

methods.name: getEncodedPassword
methods.description: Returns the encoded password, optionally based on provided commands.

methods.name: isNotEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the user account is not enabled.

methods.name: isSelfServiceUser
methods.description: Determines if the user is a self-service user.

methods.name: getAppUserClientMappings
methods.description: Returns the set of client mappings associated with the user.
